purpose: Define validation and activation of MetaModule definitions into runtime availability while keeping definition, accepted snapshot, placement and runtime state separate.

topics.name: MetaModule Runtime Activation
topics.purpose: Define validation and activation of MetaModule definitions into runtime availability while keeping definition, accepted snapshot, placement and runtime state separate.

semantics.definition_rule: Editing a MetaModule definition does not mutate an already running activation until explicit apply/reload.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Runtime activation binds to an exact accepted canonical snapshot.
semantics.placement_rule: UI placement may exist while runtime capability is inactive, and vice versa according to explicit profile.
semantics.reload_rule: Reload/replacement is explicit and preserves prior activation evidence.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed activation leaves prior valid active state or explicit inactive/error state according to policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Activation does not create rights to constituent resources.

invariants.rule: A MetaModule is an explicit composition of existing semantic capabilities; composition, placement or runtime activation never silently transfers ownership, identity or authority from constituent modules/resources.

hard_gates.condition: filesystem edit mutates live MetaModule immediately
failed reload destroys prior state without policy

references.purpose: MetaModule activation follows accepted-snapshot runtime semantics.
